correctness.rationale: For Ind(Q5), exhaustive recurrence over 32 vertices yields 254475 faces including empty. Independent recomputation using the exact source-defined vertex order constructed 127231 disjoint Morse pairs, 12 critical nonempty cells in dimensions 0(1),5(1),7(10); independently checked acyclicity by topological sorting all 254474 nonempty simplices. The Morse cellular boundary is zero because there are no critical dimensions 4 or 6, hence H5=Z and H7=Z^10 with no torsion. Each of ten coordinate-parity matchings induces 8 copies of S0 giving a 7-cycle; independent integer recurrence projects each to 10 critical seven-cells, producing 10x10 determinant -1, proving unimodular integral basis. Cube automorphisms permute these cycles without sign: permute 8 paired factors and flip oriented endpoints, with product orientation +1; independent source script explicitly checks 3840 maps. Fixed-simplex Lefschetz evaluation of bit flips/transpositions combined with H7 permutation traces gives H5 determinant/sign character (-1)^{sum t}sgn(π). No claim of wedge homotopy type or stable higher cube law.
